annotations.title: What is on: tonight, this weekend, next Saturday

description: Source-verified East End events in a date window, each with its official `sourceUrl` and the date the guide last checked it. Dates and times are East End local (America/New_York). Each event carries `access`, the organiser's own gate: `sold-out` (nothing left to buy), `approval` or `invite-only` (registering is a request the host may refuse), `members-only`, `waitlist`, or `open`; `accessNote` is the organiser's wording; an absent `access` means the record states nothing. The answer reports the total matching, whether the list was truncated, and, when nothing matches in the window, the next event in scope. Defaults to the next 7 days; returns up to 12. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

from.description: ISO date, default today (East End local)

to.description: ISO date, default from+7. The same date as `from` gives a single day.

town.description: A hamlet ('Montauk') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words.

who.description: Who is going. When omitted, programs the venue itself describes as for kids or teens only (storytime, 'grades 4-9', 'ages 2-5') are left out and counted in `leftOutForKidsOrTeens`; family events stay in. `kids`, `teens` or `family` include those programs; `everyone` returns the whole calendar.
